8. [IARC.10.1.8] If the module has per-engine state: add the
   struct member to `struct ds_engine` in `engine.h`
   at the correct position for init / teardown order
   ([IARC.3.2.5]); add init in `ds_engine_new` with
   correct error-path cleanup; add destroy in
   `ds_engine_free` before every subsystem the module
   borrows from.
